strategy_updates.pricing_theme: Systematizing aftermarket price capture as services become the main revenue growth engine
posting_evidence: Pricing Management Specialist - Temporary, Dorval QC (req 15168), posted 2026-08-28; temporary, work arrangement and salary not stated.

Mandate: execute the annual aftermarket pricing strategy across more than 200,000 parts and 9,000 products, covering parts, labour rates, technical publications, Mobile Response Team services, digital solutions and cost-per-hour programs.
Leads market-based pricing analyses and competitor benchmarking (OEMs, suppliers, dealers) and evolves pricing models to improve value capture.
Works with Sales on customer-specific pricing and discount strategies and supports Procurement and Material Logistics with cost analyses.
Tools named: Excel, Access, Power BI, Databricks; 5+ years in pricing or financial analysis; bilingual English/French required.

news.summary: Bombardier's Q2 2026 Services revenue reached a record $674 million, up 14% year over year, and drove total revenue up 6% to $2.15 billion; the company is expanding its Singapore service centre to nearly double capacity from the second half of 2028 and reaffirmed its raised 2026 guidance.

strategy_updates.interpretation: With services now the fastest-growing revenue line, Bombardier is likely trying to capture more margin from a very large parts and services catalogue through its annual price update, market-based pricing and tighter control of customer-specific discounts (inference). The breadth of scope (parts, labour rates, publications, digital and cost-per-hour programs) suggests pricing is run as a central catalogue-management function rather than deal by deal. Making this role temporary points to extra capacity for the annual price cycle or backfill, not a new strategic seat (inference). The role is analytical execution within an existing strategy, not pricing-strategy ownership.
open_questions: How long is the temporary contract, and is it cover for a leave or a bridge to a permanent role?
How much discretion does Pricing have over customer-specific discounts versus Sales?
How are cost-per-hour program rates set relative to parts list-price increases?
strategy_updates.caveat: Based on one temporary posting and one quarterly release; Bombardier publishes no aftermarket price list and the release says nothing about pricing directly.
